triggeredRiskGates.name: Liquidity Risk Gate
triggeredRiskGates.explanation: Liquidity metrics are below preferred thresholds.

triggeredRiskGates.name: Severe Liquidity Risk Gate
triggeredRiskGates.explanation: Both current and quick ratios are severely weak.

triggeredRiskGates.name: High Leverage Gate
triggeredRiskGates.explanation: Leverage is elevated versus default target bands.

triggeredRiskGates.name: Severe Leverage Gate
triggeredRiskGates.explanation: Leverage is in the severe-risk range.

triggeredRiskGates.name: Negative Equity Gate
triggeredRiskGates.explanation: Stockholders' equity is zero or negative.

triggeredRiskGates.name: Debt Maturity Pressure Gate
triggeredRiskGates.explanation: Short-term debt is high and cash coverage is weak.

triggeredRiskGates.name: Asset Quality Warning Gate
triggeredRiskGates.explanation: Goodwill and intangibles are high relative to assets.
